summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development and ran all six tasks. Each task had an implementer subagent and a reviewer subagent. It ran both soak tests (short 240 s, long 720 s, the long one as a tracked job) and dispatched a final whole-branch code review. It ran `sdd-state finish`, which published a receipt, and on my answer it fast-forward merged into main. It stopped for input three times, and each time it was asking a question. It never stopped idle mid-plan, so I never had to send "continue".
reasoning: All four criteria were met; the evidence for each is in the criteria entries. The turn stayed alive through every slow covering command: the spinner was showing during the 4-minute short soak and the 12-minute long soak, and the agent never dropped into an idle prompt before finishing.

observations.description: The HOWTO says the throwaway home is seeded with dialog-bypass state, but Claude Code still showed the theme picker, the security notes, the folder trust prompt, the 'Newer Opus model available' prompt and the bypass-permissions warning. The trust and bypass prompts both default to 'No, exit'. On the model prompt I chose 'No'; the session still showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI'.

The first commit's message has the Co-Authored-By trailer on the subject line, with no blank line before it: '3e53b09 feat: add ratelimit package with monotonic and fake clocks Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'. The final reviewer noted this but recommended leaving it.
No .gitignore was added, so ratelimit/__pycache__/ and tests/__pycache__/ are left untracked in the main checkout after the merge.

The agent asked about the decision compiler: design.md is at the repo root and has no '## Decisions' list. Nothing in the plan raised this; it is a requirement of the skill. It adds a question for the user before any work starts.

A linked worktree for branch 'hyperpowers/state' (under ~/.cache/hyperpowers/state/…) remains after the run, so `git branch -a` shows '+ hyperpowers/state'. The agent's final message said there was 'nothing else to clean up'. This is probably by design, but users may be surprised by it.
Codex review was skipped for every task and for the final review because codex-plugin-cc isn't installed. The agent logged each skip and disclosed this in its summary.
The question picker has no number-key shortcut that this harness can send, so typing a free-text answer took several Down-arrow presses to reach 'Type something.' This was minor.

criteria.criterion: The SDD skill was invoked before implementation work
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list (jq over 2e36acdc-….jsonl): the first entry is 'Skill hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development', before 'Agent Implement Task 1: Package and clocks'. The screen also showed 'Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'.

criteria.criterion: Every task was completed, the final whole-branch review was dispatched, and the work is on the main checkout
criteria.evidence: The log has Implement and Review Agent calls for Tasks 1–6, then 'Agent Final whole-branch code review'. `git log --oneline main` shows six feature/test commits up to e7481b0 on top of 6f6f0e2, and `git branch` shows '* main'. The agent wrote: 'The ratelimit work is merged into main, and all 27 unit tests pass on the merged result.' It also ran `sdd-state finish plan.md` (found in the log), and the receipts dir plan-76cc6a12-20261028T031125Z contains FINISHED, jobs and progress.md.

criteria.criterion: The soak test files were not modified
criteria.evidence: shasum before and after is identical: test_soak_long.py 5cd08cd9…, test_soak_short.py 5b4fdfd0…. `git log -- tests/test_soak_short.py tests/test_soak_long.py` lists only 6f6f0e2 (the initial commit).

STOP: "Where should the plan's work happen? You're on main in a normal checkout (not a worktree)." | question
STOP: "Let me know how you'd like to resolve each before I proceed." | question
STOP: "Which option?" | question
(The first was the workspace question, answered 'use whatever the skill recommends'. The second covered the DEFAULT_WINDOW_SECONDS conflict and the design.md/Decisions issue, answered with the scripted Task 1 answer and 'implement the plan exactly as written'. The third was the finish-option question, asked after sdd-state finish had published the receipt, answered 'merge back to main locally'. 'continue' was never sent.)
